newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Inparsa starts trade on Lisbon bourse.
newsitem.headline: Inparsa starts trade on Lisbon bourse.

text.p: Inparsa-Industria e Participacoes DGPS is admitted to the Lisbon bourse today following its creation in a restructuring of the Sonae group and dealers said it could start trading at between 1,200 and 1,400 escudos per share.
"As the Lisbon market is in uncertain mood, Inparsa shares could start trading between 1,200 and 1,400 escudos," a dealer said.
An analyst said: "I am banking on Inparsa being quoted around 1,300 escudos, but it could fall, given the negative mood in the share market. There could be a lot of sales."
Inparsa, which has a capital of 19.5 billion escudos, combines the wood products businesses of Sonae Industria and the media, computing and tourism businesses of Pargeste.
